about_the_game:
Overcome a series of challenging stages in this roguelike horde survival game by developing your power with autocasting spells across many different dimensions, including items, upgrades, talents, and more that interact with each other to produce many unique and powerful builds.

SURVIVE, EXPLORE, and ASCEND TO POWER

Crucible of the Forgotten combines the simple moment-to-moment tactical gameplay of horde survival roguelites with the depth of build crafting found in classic ARPGs and strategic evolution of the player character over a much shorter period of time.

You will rapidly gain power through your choices, defining your build as you progress through the stages in the game, with sessions taking anywhere from 10 minutes to several hours.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR BUILD

Choose from among dozens of options on character levels, spell upgrades, talents, items, resource usage, and more to build your character the way you want.

CHALLENGE MIGHTY BOSSES

At the end of most stages, face off against powerful bosses that will test your skill and push your build to its limits.

Key Features

  • Horde survival action combined with mechanical and strategic depth

  • Choose from 4 characters with unique traits that enhance different play styles

  • Play through 7 stages of 5-10 minutes each

  • Define your build by combining spells, items, upgrades, and more

  • Choose from 46 spells, each with differentiating mechanics and unique upgrades

  • Explore and find secrets in this dark fantasy tinged with occult flavor

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
